title: The Leap Second Has Been Officially Abolished
excerpt: Leap seconds, which have caused years of debate among timekeeping experts, have now been officially eliminated.
body_html:
The controversial practice of adding leap seconds to our official timekeeping system has officially ended. Although the metric generally goes unnoticed by the average person, leap seconds have generated significant debate within the global timekeeping community for years.

Now, officials have confirmed that leap seconds are no more. The decision removes a long-standing source of contention among experts who manage precise time measurements worldwide.
